text_block_list.text: A little while ago, at the URA Award Ceremony—

Air Groove was chosen
as the URA Umamusume of the Year.

The URA Umamusume of the Year is the supreme title
bestowed upon the Umamusume deemed to have had
the most outstanding performance throughout the year.

As someone who also owes her a debt of gratitude,
I watched over the awards ceremony, but—

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: “—Now then, we'd like to hear some comments from Air Groove, who was crowned Horse of the Year.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you very much for bestowing upon me
the unexpected honor of being chosen as Umamusume of the Year."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So as not to betray everyone's expectations and praise,
I intend to continue striving forward with the pride and awareness of one who carries this generation on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please look forward to this year's Twinkle Series, where my dear rivals and I
shall deliver races of the highest caliber.
(Clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai was amazing back then... wasn't she?

Truly worthy of the title "Empress."
Once again, I find myself recalling how
awed I was by her overwhelming presence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...It brings back memories. Like when McQueen was named Best Senior Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen back then was
so dignified, so majestic—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a sight...
worthy of the name 'Mejiro's Glory.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It was the same with Air Groove-senpai the other day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that presence and that strength
are what define an Umamusume who represents a generation...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know...
Air Groove-senpai is, to me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She's the ideal 'Umamusume who never stops taking on challenges.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It was the same during the Oaks.
Senpai guided me as the 'ideal' I should strive for."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I...
I want to follow in Air Groove-senpai's footsteps."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I can follow the path my senior walked...
catch up to where she is...
and become just like her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I should be able to become "The New Glory of Mejiro"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Someday, I want to follow in the glory... that Ramonu-san envisioned.
In that instant, a faint unease stirs in my chest.
Yet, before having the chance to face it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Senpai will definitely run in the upcoming Osaka Hai, right?
choice_data_list: Ah... Yeah! That must be it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Then at the Osaka Hai,
I'll show that I can get closer to Senior—to my ideal...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna fire myself up!

...Mejiro Dober is
extremely motivated.

"There's surely nothing to worry aboutâ
I told myself."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hrrrm, still not quite enough.
I need to push myself even further~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright!!
You're still out there... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Ryan~!
What a pleasant evening, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm quite a slowpoke, you see.
I was taking my sweet time training,
and before I knew it, it got this late~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, wanna take a quick break?
Let's chat for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Gulp, gulp... phew~.
That really hit the spot, it did~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ryan-onesama♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hydration is important, but...
are you eating properly too? You holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, no problem at all~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. Dear Sister, you seem
to be worrying about me an awful lot today, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Me too, you know.
During the Classic year, I always fell just short."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So... how should I put it?
There's no need for Bright to rush either, you know—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...The day after the Arima Kinen, I watched
a TV program looking back on the Classic Class season~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All that was featured there wasn't us...
but the glories of Ryan-oneesama and the other Mejiro predecessors~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However... Dober aside,
I thought it only natural
in my case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
4th in the Satsuki Sho. 3rd in the Japan Derby.
3rd in the Kikuka Sho. Unable to enter the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go so far as to call them pathetic results, but neither can I say I achieved glory.
Every race fell just one step short.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Dober fought valiantly through the Tiara races... and was even selected as a contender for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even though we pledged to "bring new glory to the Mejiro name"
and carve out the rugged path together, the two of us—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've let Dober push ahead
all on her own, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dear Sister. I have set my sights—
on the "Tenno Sho (Spring)" for my next race~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall once again achieve the cherished dream of the Mejiros.
No—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
With a run that outshines the glory of any Mejiro before me,
I shall claim the most dazzling Spring Shield for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...That is why
we must push ourselves hard right now~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To conquer the 3,200m Yodo slope and claim the Shield...
I still have a long, long way to go~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You know, Sister Ryan, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I truly love the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A long history. Dazzling glory.
The expectations people place upon this name.
And all those who bear that very same name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—I wish to weave
a new glory together with Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see. ...So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry! I totally forgot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"After tasting such bitter disappointment in the Classics...
the last thing I wanted to hear
was 'don't push yourself.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's not it... Next time!
I wanted you to see me win next time! That's what I was thinking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's why... I'm telling you the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Win, Bright.
I'm placing my hopes on you, and on your future!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Ryan...!
Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~
I have etched those words... firmly into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well then... I won't get in your way anymore!
I'll head back to the dorms first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Bright!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I will surely win, mark my words~.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I will bring a new spring of glory to the Mejiros.
